source.code:
/--
`IdempotentOp op` indicates `op` is an idempotent binary operation.
i.e. `a ∘ a = a`.
-/
class IdempotentOp (op : α → α → α) : Prop where
  /-- An idempotent operation satisfies `a ∘ a = a`. -/
  idempotent : (x : α) → op x x = x
